I've searched the forum and online but haven't found any clear details about getting the license as a direct download, USB stick, or another medium that doesn't require a CD drive. Does anyone know if [company_name] offers a downloadable version of the [product_name] license, or if there's any official way to get it without needing a physical CD? Thanks in advance for any info!

No, the license isn't available like those for [product_name] or [product_name]. The license comes only as an original installation CD or DVD. This topic has come up frequently on the forum. [company_name] continues to use the traditional method of distributing the installation CD or DVD for [product_name].
Looks like I'll need to get an external CD drive then. I honestly expected that by 2025 there would be an option to download the license. Thanks for the quick response!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are frustrated with the lack of digital download or non-physical licensing options for [product_name], especially since many modern laptops don't include CD/DVD drives.
